messages.text:
Under 12¢ is good power — that's where these actually make sense. The H15 Dual's drop hasn't opened yet, so the one you can buy today is the Harlo B30 at $899, ~30 TH/s of real block-lottery draws.

Is this your first miner?
I mined a lot before and now, only a bit of AI leasing

Then you know the drill. At under 12¢, the B30 runs ~360–450W, so about $26–32 a month in power for 30 TH/s of block draws, plus steady sats to your own wallet. $899, ~50 dB, ships Nov 30.

The Magic Miner 40T at $799 is cheaper per TH. Budget or quiet matter more?
in my garage. So heat and noise not a problem, but looking for best efficiency

On pure efficiency the B30 wins: 30 TH/s at 360–450W, so roughly 12–15 J/TH. The Magic Miner is ~16 J/TH at 40 TH/s, 650W — more hashrate, about $47 a month in power versus ~$29 for the B30 at your rate.

B30 at $899, ships Nov 30. Want me to build that cart?
Even at 10cents/kwh and 30th/s, I lose money every month?

Straight answer: at 10¢ the pooled sats usually come to less than the ~$29 of power, yes.

What you're buying is the block shot — 30 TH/s draws on a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, for years, and you keep the machine. Plus real sats to your own wallet, no KYC.

Still worth it to you?
how many btc per month per machine

It moves with difficulty and price, so I won't guess a figure at you. I've asked our team to run today's exact sats-per-month for a 30 TH/s B30 at 10¢ — Georges will confirm by email, usually within one business day, and he can jump into this chat too.
